target_customer: Urban households buying groceries online for delivery in under 60 minutes, and later other grocers licensing its software
problem: Supermarket runs for staples were a chore and existing grocery delivery was layered over supermarkets. Farmstead ran its own delivery only hubs with software for fresh, local groceries.
business_model: Online grocery retail margin plus delivery fees from owned dark store hubs, with Grocery OS software for other retailers

founders.name: Pradeep Elankumaran
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Kicksend and jo as co-founded companies.

founders.name: Kevin Li
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CMO.

exit.reason: In July 2022 Farmstead stopped operating in four of five markets and cut 22 percent of operations staff, calling it a pause; later status not found

competitors.name: Instacart
competitors.what: Same day grocery delivery from existing supermarkets

competitors.name: Good Eggs
competitors.what: Online local food and grocery delivery in the Bay Area
competitors.traction_then: Relaunching under a new CEO in 2016 with outsourced logistics

technical_complexity.rationale: Ecommerce plus demand forecasting and hub operations; the hard parts were fresh supply chain and delivery logistics rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: Grocery delivery was copyable by Instacart, Amazon and local players with deeper pockets; own hubs added operational cost rather than a moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Instacart raised $400 million in 2017 and Amazon and Walmart expanded grocery delivery; Farmstead pulled back from four markets in 2022.

market_need_then: AgFunder (2018-12) says Farmigo, a farm to table delivery startup, ceased operations in July 2016, while Instacart and Good Eggs continued to raise, showing demand with difficult economics.

branding.domain_note: Company site used farmsteadapp.com, an app suffixed domain.
branding.community_and_virality: Press about the company (Business Insider, TechCrunch, Grocery Dive) and a founder story of polling a Nextdoor community for demand; nothing on merch or fans.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic farm word that suggests local freshness; searches for the brand return farm themed products not the company, and no brand pull evidence exists.

pivots.to: Grocery e-commerce with Grocery OS software sold to other grocers
pivots.why: Reported in 2020 Series A coverage; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Farmstead launched in 2017, raised a Series A style round of $2.2 million in 2018 and a $7.9 million round in 2020, and expanded to several markets. In July 2022 it stopped operating in four of five markets citing economic uncertainty and capital efficiency, kept San Francisco and called it a pause; no later press confirms a restart and YC lists it inactive, so the final cause is not public.
notes: Company site farmsteadapp.com did not resolve during fetch so treated as dead or unreachable. Both the 2018 and 2020 rounds are labelled Series A by their outlets; the labels conflict and both are recorded as stated. TechCrunch says $14.7M total by 2020-11 while other outlets say $14.5M. AgFunder says $7.5M total by 2018-12; recorded rounds sum to $5.0M with the seed, so about $2.5M (likely YC and angels) is unaccounted for. The $2.8M seed comes from a Business Insider India search snippet, not an opened article, and its date is only the year. CB Insights lists a bankrupt status, which conflicts with Grocery Dive's pause, so exit stays unknown. Cofounder jo and Kraken roles are later. Education not found. Good Eggs source is a July 2016 Xconomy listing seen in a search result.
